name: Milton Keynes centre car park
description: A surface car park wedged between a shopping centre and the grid roads. Flat and firm, but hemmed in.
attribution: Terrain: Terrain Tiles (AWS Open Data / Mapzen), including data from SRTM, GMTED2010, ETOPO1, EU-DEM (Copernicus) and national LIDAR sources

axes: metres; x east, y up, z south (-z is north); y = 0 is the plot's mean ground level

terrain.encoding: float32le, row-major, rows run +z (north to south), columns run +x (west to east)

factors.label: Tight access
factors.detail: Access is by only a narrow service road (3.5 m wide). Limits crane and delivery sizes.

factors.label: Road or path crosses the plot
factors.detail: Crossed by service, cycleway. It must be diverted or kept open.

factors.label: Neighbours close to the boundary
factors.detail: 1 building(s) within 6 m of the boundary, the nearest 1.4 m away. Needs careful excavation, scaffolding and demolition.

factors.label: Sloping site
factors.detail: Falls about 3% to the south-east, 2.0 m across the plot. Expect cut and fill, retaining walls or stepped foundations.

factors.label: Made ground
factors.detail: Previously developed land: buried foundations, fill and possible contamination. Trial pits recommended.
